user.title: Pair with your Centsible bridge
user.description: In the Centsible app, open More → Settings → Household, add a member for Home Assistant (a Viewer is enough), and tap Invite.

data_description.pairing_code: The code under the invite QR code (like ABCD-EFGH), or the whole actualbridge://pair link the QR code holds.
data_description.bridge_url: Your bridge's public address, e.g. https://budget-api.example.com. Not needed when you paste the link.

cloudflare_access.name: Cloudflare Access
cloudflare_access.description: Only if the bridge is behind Cloudflare Access and you typed the code instead of pasting the link (the link carries these).

budget.title: Choose a budget
budget.description: This member can open more than one budget. Add the integration again for each budget you want.

reauth_confirm.title: Pair again
reauth_confirm.description: The bridge no longer accepts Home Assistant's sign-in for {budget} (the device was removed, or it wasn't used for 90 days). Make a new invite in the app and enter it here.

data_description.pairing_code: The code under the invite QR code (like ABCD-EFGH), or the whole actualbridge://pair link the QR code holds.
data_description.bridge_url: Your bridge's public address, e.g. https://budget-api.example.com. Not needed when you paste the link.

error.invalid_code: That pairing code is wrong, used, or expired. Codes work once, for 10 minutes.
error.invalid_link: That pairing link has no code in it.
error.url_required: Enter the bridge address, or paste the whole pairing link.
error.invalid_url: That doesn't look like a web address.
error.rate_limited: Too many wrong codes from here. Wait 10 minutes and try again.
error.cannot_connect: Can't reach the bridge. Check the address, and the Cloudflare Access service token if you use one.
error.budget_not_shared: That member can't open this budget any more.

abort.already_configured: This budget is already set up.
abort.no_budgets: This member can't open any budgets yet.

data_description.scan_interval: How often to ask the bridge for new numbers.
data_description.currency: Actual doesn't store a currency; this is the unit on money sensors (e.g. USD).
